claim_text: Low dairy intake alone does not establish low calcium intake because non-dairy foods and fortified products also contribute; total intake should be assessed against age- and life-stage reference values before considering a supplement.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe assessment of nutrient intake and avoid inappropriate or duplicate supplementation.

population.other_context: People reporting low dairy and fortified-food intake; assess all dietary sources and current products.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food, fortified foods and/or relevant supplement preparations; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Calcium Health Professional Fact Sheet lists dietary sources, reference intakes and upper limits.
limitations: No supplement dose from this claim; account for kidney-stone history and total elemental calcium.
Source claim and cited underlying studies require full-text appraisal before approval.
